Day 3

Step 4 (continued): Authentication (JWT)

Login

  1. 01Receive email and password
  2. 02Find user
  3. 03Compare password using bcrypt
  4. 04Create JWT with userId
  5. 05Return token and user info

Career Assistant Additions

No special changes here.
But the UI copy in React should call the user:

  • “Job Seeker” / “Candidate” (optional)

Step 5: Auth Middleware

Create: server/middleware/authMiddleware.js

Responsibilities:

  1. 01Read Authorization header (Bearer <token>)
  2. 02Verify JWT
  3. 03Attach req.user = { id: userId }
  4. 04Block access if token is missing or invalid

Career Assistant Additions

All career data is private:

  • Resume analysis results are personal
  • History must always be filtered by req.user.id
←→

Mandatory Rules

  1. 01Every user-related route must be protected with JWT
  2. 02Never store plain-text passwords
  3. 03Filter all data by req.user.id
  4. 04Return proper HTTP status codes
  5. 05Never trust client-side user IDs

Career Assistant Additions (extra mandatory rules)

  • Never store the AI API key on the client
  • Save every AI result as a history item (recommended)
  • Do not return private user fields in populate (email only)
